recognize_zh: 原始細胞閘門內的核 TdT 對胞質 MPO 流式圖：原始細胞普遍 TdT 弱到中度陽性（約 10³–2×10⁴）；綠色 B 系原始細胞 MPO 低，紅色族群中有一明顯的 MPO 陽性次群（約 3×10⁴–10⁵ 以上），代表同一檢體內同時有 TdT+ 的 B 系與 MPO+ 的骨髓系原始細胞。
features: Gated on blasts; nuclear TdT-FITC (x-axis) versus cytoplasmic MPO-PE (y-axis)
Blasts broadly TdT dim to moderately positive (about 10^3 to 2x10^4)
Green (B-lineage, cCD79a-positive) blasts with low MPO (about 10^3 to 10^4)
Red blast subset with distinctly positive MPO (about 3x10^4 to 5x10^5) and partial TdT expression
Continuous smear between the MPO-low and MPO-positive regions without a sharply separate cluster
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis gated on blasts displays nuclear TdT versus cytoplasmic MPO. Blasts show dim to moderate TdT expression, confirming immaturity. The green, B-lineage-committed blasts have low MPO, whereas a red blast subset shows distinctly positive MPO with partial TdT co-expression. The presence of an MPO-positive blast subset alongside B-lineage blasts fulfills myeloid and B-lineage criteria, and the findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.vs: TdT-positive blasts lack a distinct MPO-positive subset exceeding the level of normal lymphocytes.
TdT can be expressed in AML, but the blasts lack strong CD19 with CD79a, cCD22 or CD10.
Normal promyelocytes and myelocytes are MPO bright with higher side scatter and are TdT negative.
